tei:titleStmt.tei:title: Vidui and 13 Middot: Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before y

tei:div.tei:p: Our God and God of our fathers, let our prayer come before you and do not ignore our supplication. For we are not so brazen-faced and stiff-necked to say to you, Adonoy, our God, and God of our fathers, We are righteous and have not sined. But, indeed, we and our fathers have sinned.
